name: io.github.tonyyang0504/tiktok-social-mcp
description: TikTok (social): me, publish_image, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CLIENT_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Client key of your TikTok for Developers app (https://developers.tiktok.com/apps).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret of the same app.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: The creator's refresh_token from the Login Kit authorization-code exchange (POST /v2/oauth/token/, valid 365 days) with scopes user.info.basic, video.publish, video.list. Access tokens (24 h) are minted from it; a rotated refresh_token replaces it (persisted when PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR is set).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TIKTOK_PRIVACY_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: privacy_level for direct photo posts: one of the creator's privacy_level_options from /v2/post/publish/creator_info/query/ (PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, SELF_ONLY). Unaudited apps can only use SELF_ONLY.
